🔮 On the Horizon.title: Didactic knowledge or Clinical Cases? How Data Types Shape Medical Large Language Models
🔮 On the Horizon.summary: arXiv:2609.22161v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Medical large language models are commonly trained on mixtures of didactic data (e.g., textbooks) and clinical data (e.g., patient records), yet how these data types differentially shape model capabilities remains unclear. We address this issue with token-matched experiments that vary the didactic-to-clinical ratio and analyze how data composition affects performance, capability profiles, and error patterns…

🔮 On the Horizon.title: An Affordable AI-Integrated Smart Cane for Multimodal Mobility Assistance of Visually Impaired Users
🔮 On the Horizon.summary: arXiv:2609.22277v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Visual impairment affects over 2.2 billion people worldwide, yet conventional white canes cannot detect elevated hazards or provide semantic environmental context. Existing AI-assisted navigation systems typically rely on expensive hardware or cloud connectivity, limiting accessibility in resource-constrained settings. This paper presents an affordable (\$88 USD), fully offline AI-integrated smart cane designed for multimodal mobility assistance…
